title: BiasGuard: A Reasoning-Enhanced Bias Detection Tool for Large Language Models
findings: The proposed tool, BiasGuard, demonstrates superior reasoning capabilities by correctly identifying complex statements about religious groups. For instance, it can distinguish between a biased stereotype and a criticism of that stereotype (e.g., a statement about Muslims), leading to more accurate and less overly-sensitive bias judgments.
